attchmntText: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update of Material Subsidiary'.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Industries Limited disclosed that its listed material subsidiary, Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited, filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited reported Q2 FY'27 topline growth of 16% to Rs. 2,057 crores and PBT of Rs. 138 crores. Pig iron production reached 3,31,896 metric tons for six months, while casting production rose 20% to 93,000 metric tons. The company announced phase two of the Solapur casting foundry is nearly complete, with Rajpura phase two expected by March 31st. The Koppal alloy steel plant project is in commercial negotiation, with execution expected in two to three months. Managing Director R. V. Gumaste confirmed succession planning is underway but declined to provide specific timelines.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update of Material Subsidiary'.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Industries Limited informs the stock exchanges that its listed material subsidiary, Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited, has filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations with the relevant stock exchange. The company states that the copy of the intimation filed by Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited is enclosed for reference. The document does not specify the content of the intimation filed by the subsidiary. Kirloskar Industries Limited requests the exchanges to take the information on record. The announcement was issued on 7 November 2026 by Ashwini Mali, Company Secretary of Kirloskar Industries Limited.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update of Material Subsidiary'.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Industries Limited has disclosed that its listed material subsidiary, Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited, filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding the results of a postal ballot. The scrutinizer's report confirms that two ordinary resolutions were passed with the required majority. The first resolution approved the appointment of Mr. Ajay Shriram Patil, DIN 01217000, as a Director of the Company. The second resolution approved his appointment as Joint Managing Director and the terms of his remuneration. The e-voting period for these resolutions ran from 7th October 2026 to 5 November 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility was 2 October 2026. The report was signed by Manasi Paradkar on 6 November 2026.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Industries Limited published its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 06 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, standalone total income was 62.43 Crores, with a profit after tax of 41.12 Crores. Consolidated total income for the same period stood at 2,097.95 Crores, with a profit after tax of 104.60 Crores. The paid-up equity share capital remains at 10.51 Crores. Standalone basic earnings per share for the quarter were 39.13, while consolidated basic earnings per share were 48.58. The results were published in the Financial Express and Loksatta on 7 November 2026.
